claims: Minnesota Timberwolves defeated Houston Rockets 110-108 in overtime on March 25, 2026.
Houston Rockets defeated Minnesota Timberwolves 110-105 on January 16, 2026.
Julius Randle hit the go-ahead jumper with 8.8 seconds remaining in overtime in the Minnesota Timberwolves vs. Houston Rockets game on March 25, 2026 in Minneapolis.
Kevin Durant scored 39 points to lead Houston Rockets to a home victory over Minnesota Timberwolves on January 16, 2026.
